skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the fundamental principles of Vietnamese Criminal Law, including the definition and classification of crimes, the stages of criminal acts, and the determination of criminal responsibility and penalties.
Analyze specific criminal behaviors to determine if they constitute crimes and to identify the principles for determining penalties.
Demonstrate effective communication skills in presenting and discussing legal concepts.
Develop independent research skills to accumulate and enhance knowledge.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on legal topics.
Engage in critical thinking to analyze and discuss legal issues.
